concepts.title: Relay tech — one click, large meeting
concepts.hook: ONE CLICK AWAY FROM A VERY LARGE MEETING.
concepts.concept_text: A tiny action can create enormous organizational consequences.
concepts.purchase_reason: Memorable high-consequence workplace humor with strong coworker gift appeal.
concepts.differentiation: Peers know exactly why one wrong click can suddenly involve a very large meeting.
concepts.visual_direction_text: Tiny switch casting a huge conference-room shadow.
concepts.meaning: A tiny action can create enormous organizational consequences. Peers know exactly why one wrong click can suddenly involve a very large meeting.
concepts.ip_summary: Preliminary common-law screen: no obvious exact apparel collision observed.

concepts.differentiation: I&C techs have actually been asked versions of the setup question.
concepts.visual_direction_text: Concert-poster layout with a process signal replacing a musical waveform.
concepts.meaning: Someone misunderstands your profession as a musical one. I&C techs have actually been asked versions of the setup question.
